text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
What an overwhelming aura... A single mistake could cost us our lives.
We'll need to fight at maximum efficiency!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ものすごい圧力ね……
少しのミスが命取りになりそうだわ。
効率的に戦うわよ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Roger that! I'll show that fish that this cat's got claws!
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解にゃ！　
本気の猫を見せてやるのにゃー！
